source_text: 改革开放以来，中国人民生活水平不断提高，这在人们的饮食（diet）变化上得到充分体现。如今, 人们不再满足于吃得饱，而是追求吃得更加安全、更加营养、更加健康，食物也愈来愈丰富多样，不 再限于本地的农产品。 （logistics industry）的发展使人们很容易品尝到全国各地的特产。毫无 疑问，食品质量与饮食结构的改善为增进人们健康提供了有力的保障。 «
reference_translation: Since the reform and opening-up, the living standards of the Chinese people have been continuously improving, which is fully reflected in the changes of people's diet. Nowadays, people are no longer satisfied with having enough to eat. Instead, they pursue a diet that is safer, more nutritious and healthier. The food has also become increasingly rich and diverse, no longer limited to local agricultural products. The development of the logistics industry enables people to easily taste special local products from all over the country. Undoubtedly, the improvement of food quality and diet structure provides a strong guarantee for enhancing people's health.
